name: textarea
title: Textarea
docs: Raster leaves are StyleX. Compile them with @stylexjs/babel-plugin (Vite: @stylexjs/unplugin, Next: @stylexjs/nextjs-plugin). If you would rather not run a compiler, import @noorddev/raster-react instead: it ships precompiled with one stylesheet.

raster.snippet: Notes
raster.example:
import { Textarea } from "@noorddev/raster-react";

<Textarea label="Notes" placeholder="What should we know?" rows={4} />

use: Free text longer than one line.
Vertical resize only; the width follows the grid.
avoid: Rich text; this is a native textarea.

keyboard.does: Moves focus to the field; Enter inserts a line break

a11y: A native <textarea> with a generated id; label renders a <label> pointing at it.
Inside Field, hint and error reach it through aria-describedby and aria-invalid.
